title: Tracking House races for 2026 midterms | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

Vote counting will continue well beyond Election Day, with several key House races still too close for CNN to project a winner. Counting procedures vary by state, meaning some races could be decided quickly while others may take days.

Below are the House races where CNN has yet to project a winner, along with estimates of the ballots remaining to be counted in each.

Check back and follow along as results start coming in on Election Night — these graphics will update as CNN projects these races.
